verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents official Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java SDKs and publishes an official langsmith-sdk GitHub repo with a usage example (wrap_openai). A community comment also references the SDK's @traceable decorator in practice. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference documentation per language, and evidence of the maturity of the Go and Java SDKs beyond a single listing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Trace your preferred framework or integrate LangSmith with any agent stack using our Python, Typescript, Go, or Java SDKs.
Add tracing to your app in minutes with environment variables, framework integrations, or the SDK.
Unify traces when calling your deployed Agent Server from another service using RemoteGraph or the SDK.
